email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing & Communication Internship at CBRE. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background: I write SEO content that ranks, build and manage sites in WordPress, and report on performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.

Every week I publish and update pages and blog posts for client sites — a pharmacists' association with around 600 member pages, two Shopify stores — which has taught me to keep messaging consistent across channels and to work to a deadline.

I work in English daily, my Dutch writing is at B1 and improving, and I use Canva and AI tools to produce content quickly without losing accuracy. What draws me to CBRE is the mix of internal and external communication — events, press releases, social and internal screens — and the chance to learn that craft from a team that does it at scale.

I'd be glad to talk about how I can support the Marketing & Communication Manager.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Marketing & Communication Internship at CBRE. My route into marketing didn't run through a marketing degree — I studied Applied Computer Science at Karel de Grote Hogeschool in Antwerp — but it shaped how I work. I build the site, write the content, then measure what it does. That loop is what keeps me interested.

Alongside my freelance SEO work, I'm a junior digital marketer at Episto, a remote agency. In a typical week I research keywords, write and publish blog and web content for client sites, and report on the results in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I've built and maintained sites in WordPress and Elementor, including a pharmacists' association with a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages, and I manage two Shopify stores where I handle the catalogue and the blog. Keeping several clients moving at once has made me organised out of necessity.

Writing is the part I care most about. I work in English every day, I've written for sites read in Belgium and Türkiye, and I check details before anything goes out. My Dutch writing is at B1 and improving, so I can handle Dutch content while I get better at it.

What attracts me to CBRE is the range of the role: events, press releases, social media, the website, internal screens, and the reporting behind all of it. I'd like to learn how a communication team works at that scale, and to bring the digital and analytical side with me.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about what I could contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
Writes and publishes SEO content in English daily — web pages, blog posts and product copy for client sites in Belgium and Türkiye, including a pharmacists' association with roughly 600 member profile pages and two Shopify stores
Reports on marketing performance using Google Analytics (GA4 certified), Google Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, turning the data into recommendations for future content
Manages content across WordPress, Elementor, Astra, Rank Math, WooCommerce and Shopify, and creates visuals and campaign assets in Canva
Languages: English fluent, Turkish native, Dutch writing B1 and speaking A2+ — comfortable producing English copy, actively improving Dutch
Organised across multiple clients and projects at once, with a technical base (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, daily AI tools) that makes new platforms and digital tools quick to pick up
